284745282.description:
Artist Unknown
Man with Pipe and Jug at Barrel
Oil on Canvas
18.4" x 13.2" (Framed)
Unsigned (Inscribed Verso)
This evocative genre painting depicts an elderly man in a cap, resting his chin in hand while smoking a pipe beside a wooden barrel and glazed earthenware jug. Rendered in deep earthen greens and warm ochres with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, the composition echoes traditional Dutch and Flemish tavern character studies.
Verso stretcher bar features red lettering reading "R. VANDENKERCKHOVE"
Textural impasto brushwork on facial features, rising pipe smoke, and jug glaze
Stretched canvas on original keyed wood stretcher with wire hanger
Housed in molded silver and gold tone wood frame, 18.4" x 13.2" x 2" overall
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Paint surface is stable with fine age-appropriate craquelure and no tears or repairs. Frame exhibits minor finish wear and edge rubbing consistent with age, remaining structurally sound.

Spiritual Smudging Kit with Crystals, Agate Slices, Abalone Shell, Sage, Palo
This spiritual smudging and crystal kit includes a variety of items for cleansing and metaphysical use. The kit contains a box and several bags with assorted raw and polished crystals and minerals, identified by a gemstone chart. Included are two polished agate slices and a large abalone shell. The smudging materials consist of several palo santo wood sticks, sage bundles, and a feather. A brown suede pouch featuring fringe and an embroidered steer skull with feather design is also part of the set. A 'Smudging Guide' pamphlet is included. The items are gently used, with crystals and minerals in natural forms and smudging materials well preserved.
